title: Arnhemse meisjes
hookLine: Global-inspired arnhemse meisjes with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Arnhemse meisjes
steps.instructionTemplate: Take your puff pastry from the freezer and defrost. Sprinkle some flour on the kitchen counter. Stack the sheets of puff pastry on top of each other and roll them out with a rolling pin. You want those five sheets to end up being as thin as one sheet. Using a round or oval form press into the puff pastry and try to be as economical doing that as possible. You want to have as many cookies as you can. Incorporate {m53392_1}, {m53392_2}, {m53392_3}, and {m53392_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure puff pastry first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix the vanilla sugar with the cinnamon, cardemom and limezest in a little bowl Remove the flour from the counter and sprinkle with a bit of the sugar mix. Brush your puff pastry with a little bit of eggwash and than dip into the sugar mix and roll them softly to press the sugar in. Incorporate {m53392_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Put your sugary puff pastry on a baking sheet (greased or with baking paper) and leave the dough to rest for about 20 to 25 minutes. this will make the cookies even crisper. Preheat the oven in the meantime to 180 C and put the baking tray in the oven. bake the cookies golden brown in about 25 minutes and make sure the sugar is caramelised nicely.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: And voila, Girls from Arnhem with an Almeerse twist Voila, Arnhemse Meisjes met een Almeerse twist. Let Arnhemse meisjes cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 38 mins!
